
{{alias}}( results )
    Serializes a one-sample t-test results object as a JSON object.

    Parameters
    ----------
    results: Object
        One-sample t-test results object.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object
        Serialized object.

    Examples
    --------
    > var res = {
    ...    'rejected': true,
    ...    'alpha': 0.05,
    ...    'pValue': 0.0031,
    ...    'statistic': 4.0,
    ...    'df': 9.0,
    ...    'nullValue': 0.0,
    ...    'mean': 1.2,
    ...    'sd': 0.3,
    ...    'ci': new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.5214, 1.8786 ] ),
    ...    'alternative': 'two-sided',
    ...    'method': 'One-sample t-test'
    ... };
    > var o = {{alias}}( res )
    {...}

    --------
